ctx.title: Chiranjeevi’s OTT Series Megaverse: Megastar drops first glimpse of upcoming chat show, calls it ‘Iddhi Na Adda’
ctx.summary:
Chiranjeevi is all set to host a new chat show on the OTT platform Netflix, titled Megaverse. The show will feature the Megastar engaging in candid conversations with guests from the worlds of cinema, sports, and popular culture. They will share interesting stories and discuss their personal and professional lives. 
 Chiranjeevi’s Megaverse Teaser 
 The show will give viewers an opportunity to see  Chiranjeevi  in a different role. Beyond his popular on-screen image, the actor will have casual, honest conversations with his guests, with plenty of humour along the way. In the teaser, Chiranjeevi introduces the show by saying, “Iddhi Na Adda” (This is my territory). 
 The OTT space has yet to announce the show's release date. According to online reports, the show is expected to premiere on November 30. The platform has not officially confirmed the date or time. 
 Chiranjeevi’s work front 
 Chiranjeevi is next set to headline  Kaaka , directed by Bobby Kolli. The action thriller is scheduled for a theatrical release on January 13, 2027, coinciding with the Sankranti festive season. 
 The film reportedly follows a family man who leads an ordinary life with his daughter while concealing a mysterious side of his personality. Produced by Venkat K. Narayana under the banner of KVN Productions, Kaaka also features Anaswara Rajan in a pivotal role.
